authorization: User confirmed one new Breakglass subscription call; the retrospective Expert call is excluded from this new allowance.
accounting_basis: subscription quota, not metered consumption spend
retry_policy: No retries. Reserve the call before dispatch, including interrupted or quota-blocked requests; an existing reservation or output prevents a second call.
auth_precondition: OpenAI OAuth credential with account ID, no API-key credential field, no OPENAI_API_KEY, and no OpenAI API-key/provider override in resolved config. Do not persist credentials or account identifier.
isolation: Transient OPENCODE_CONFIG fragment adds only an experiment primary. It inherits global defaults exactly as Breakglass does; resolved permissions are compared with active Breakglass before dispatch. No global config write and no Task invocation.
stop_policy: Rate limit or quota error is QUOTA_BLOCKED, not model failure; stop immediately. Other provider errors stop too. Null derived_credits is allowed only as subscription-call accounting, never converted to credits.
evidence_boundary: Successful primary inference with requested model/variant, not role fitness or provider attestation of reasoning effort. Runtime token metadata retained as reported, not billing measurement. Current OAuth authentication is observed; historical Expert authentication was not independently captured at its dispatch time.
